capabilities: Fetch recent Pinboard posts and insert them into the daily note for each link's date
Import Pinboard tags with a configurable prefix
Create one note per pin in a configurable folder with title formatting
Re-sync automatically at a set interval or on demand
Configure section heading, separators, and number of recent posts (up to 100)
disambiguation: Not a vault or device syncing tool; it imports bookmarks from the Pinboard service into notes.
extras: Warns that the initial sync may create or modify up to ~100 files and recommends testing in a new vault; does not support Pinboard Notes; mentions switching from Roam.
motivation: The author used Pinboard for years to save links and wanted them stored in Obsidian daily notes to revisit and add notes about each site.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull links saved with the Pinboard bookmarking service into daily notes for later reference and annotation.

relations.evidence: This plugin was made possible by the awesome work by liamcain and mrled

summary: Fetches recent Pinboard.in bookmarks and adds them, with tags, to the daily notes matching the date each link was saved.
